versions.content: The API parameter Channel shall have a value within the d e- fined channels in the initiali zation data structure, and the correct type of channel (IB or EB) has to be used with services. Related error value: SPI_E_PARAM_CHANNEL . Otherwise, the service is not done and the return value shall be E_NOT_OK .
